overall_progress.label: COMPETING_MODELS_DOCUMENTED
overall_progress.meaning: The question has bounded definitions, competing explanations and candidate evidence pathways. The rating does not estimate truth or the probability that a field exists.

axis_assessments.label: RELEVANT_EVIDENCE_ACCUMULATING
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: Kindness and loving-kindness practices have evidence for some positive-emotion and wellbeing outcomes.
axis_assessments.boundary: Effects vary and do not establish access to an external field.

axis_assessments.label: RELEVANT_EVIDENCE_ACCUMULATING
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: A meta-analysis of 60 experiments reported a medium effect of interpersonal synchrony on prosocial attitudes and behaviours.
axis_assessments.boundary: The synthesis spans multiple experiments, but this assessment has not independently verified a Level 6 replication threshold; social coordination also does not demonstrate nonlocal consciousness or a cosmic field.

axis_assessments.label: RELEVANT_EVIDENCE_ACCUMULATING
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: Meditation interventions show qualified effects on compassion and empathy.
axis_assessments.boundary: Methodological quality moderates findings; effects were not general across aggression, connectedness or prejudice.

axis_assessments.label: RELEVANT_EVIDENCE_ACCUMULATING
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: Nature connectedness is associated with pro-environmental behaviour.
axis_assessments.boundary: Association with ecological care does not show communion with a conscious cosmos.

axis_assessments.label: COMPETING_MODELS_DOCUMENTED
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: Reports of unity, sacred relatedness and encompassing love provide phenomenological and testimonial research targets.
axis_assessments.boundary: A reported experience does not by itself establish an external field or authenticate perceived beings.

axis_assessments.label: TERMS_AND_BOUNDARIES_CLARIFIED
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: Nonlocal access is a distinguishable hypothesis requiring prospective information-verification tests.
axis_assessments.boundary: No source in this assessment is accepted as replicated evidence of nonlocal access.

axis_assessments.label: QUESTION_DEFINED
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: The pre-existing love-field model is now accurately stated.
axis_assessments.boundary: Its independent existence and intrinsic quality remain unconfirmed.

axis_assessments.label: COMPETING_MODELS_DOCUMENTED
axis_assessments.bounded_finding: Receiver/filter, fundamental-consciousness and love-field interpretations can be compared without treating coherence as empirical confirmation.
axis_assessments.boundary: Philosophical or contemplative coherence is Interpretation, Hypothesis or Speculation according to the claim.

sources.title: The effect of loving-kindness meditation on positive emotions: a meta-analytic review
limitations: More studies are needed to identify active components.
Positive-emotion effects do not establish field access.

sources.title: The limited prosocial effects of meditation: A systematic review and meta-analysis
limitations: Effects were qualified by outcome type and methodological quality.
Meditation outcomes do not establish cosmic ontology.

sources.title: Prosocial Consequences of Interpersonal Synchrony: A Meta-Analysis
limitations: Intentionality and experimenter effects moderated outcomes.
Interpersonal synchrony is not evidence of a nonlocal field.

sources.title: Meta-analysis of human connection to nature and proenvironmental behavior
limitations: Predominantly correlational evidence limits causal inference.
Nature connectedness is not equivalent to cosmic consciousness.

level_4: Operationalise love, access, alignment and field without collapsing distinct meanings.
Specify model-discriminating predictions before data collection.
Define prospective tests for independently verifiable information and durable behavioural effects.
Include neutral, negative and failed outcomes.
level_5: Complete preregistered studies with active controls.
Accumulate relevant evidence across cultures and research groups.
Test expectation, suggestion, sensory leakage and cultural-exposure explanations.
level_6: Achieve independent replication across cultures and research groups.
